questions.question: Why does `build_runtime_receipt()` run `jax.pmap` across `jax.local_devices()` and call `jax.block_until_ready` instead of only checking `jax.default_backend()`?
options: To exercise and synchronize a small computation on the visible local devices, beyond merely enumerating them
Because `jax.pmap` automatically deletes the Cloud TPU VM
questions.explanation: With the backend explicitly checked, mapped arithmetic and an independent expected sum exercise this small local-device contract. This does not qualify all chips on other hosts, the full model, precision paths or performance.
optionFeedback: Backend discovery does not alter the environment. The extra computation tests a small operation on the visible local devices.

With the backend explicitly checked, mapped arithmetic and an independent expected sum exercise this small local-device contract. This does not qualify all chips on other hosts, the full model, precision paths or performance.
pmap executes a mapped function; it does not manage cloud resources. Cleanup is a separate control-plane operation.
